correctness.rationale: The four contiguous James segment partitions yield q0+2 max(h0,h1,h2,h3). Rewriting the C_NJ quotient as [E+m(x+y)+m(x-y)]/[E+2M], the six pairwise symmetric correction-matrix differences have spectra ±1/2 or ±1/sqrt2 except 0-vs-3 which has {-1,1/2,1/2}. Recomputed all six matrices and spectra symbolically with SymPy. The exceptional h3 has eigen {1,-1/2,-1/2}; its two-case positive-part scalar estimate controls the cross term. The sharp vectors give two denominator norm squares 2 and two numerator norm squares 4+2sqrt2. No infinite-dimensional extension is claimed.
